questions.question_text: What is the primary role of body language in communication, as discussed in the chapter?

options.text: To replace verbal communication entirely
To send unspoken messages through posture and gestures that show confidence or nervousness
To distract the audience from the speaker’s words
To only be used in formal settings like speechesCorrect Answer:B. To send unspoken messages through posture and gestures that show confidence or nervousness

questions.question_text: According to the chapter, how do facial expressions enhance a speaker’s message?

options.text: They make the speaker appear more serious regardless of the topic
They add authenticity and emotional connection by matching the speaker’s feelings to their words
They are unnecessary if the speaker’s tone is clear
They should always remain neutral to avoid confusionCorrect Answer:B. They add authenticity and emotional connection by matching the speaker’s feelings to their words

questions.question_text: What is one benefit of maintaining appropriate eye contact, as highlighted in the chapter?

options.text: It makes the speaker appear more intimidating to the audience
It builds trust and engagement by showing attention and sincerity
It allows the speaker to avoid looking at their notes
It is only important in one-on-one conversations, not group settingsCorrect Answer:B. It builds trust and engagement by showing attention and sincerity

questions.question_text: How does the chapter suggest balancing eye contact to avoid discomfort?

options.text: By staring at the audience without breaking eye contact at all
By avoiding eye contact entirely to focus on the message
By holding eye contact for a few seconds, then briefly looking away before reconnecting
By only looking at one person in the audience for the entire timeCorrect Answer:C. By holding eye contact for a few seconds, then briefly looking away before reconnecting

questions.question_text: What does the chapter say about personal space in communication?

options.text: It is the same for everyone regardless of culture or context
It is the physical distance between people that shows respect and comfort, varying by culture
It should always be as close as possible to build connection
It is irrelevant in public speaking situationsCorrect Answer:B. It is the physical distance between people that shows respect and comfort, varying by culture

questions.question_text: What is a key tip from the chapter for using movement effectively during a presentation?

options.text: To pace back and forth constantly to keep the audience’s attention
To stay completely still to avoid any distraction
To plan purposeful movements, like stepping forward for emphasis, tied to key points
To move randomly to appear more energeticCorrect Answer:C. To plan purposeful movements, like stepping forward for emphasis, tied to key points
